svg.text: Each box is one interface from the briefing,
FK (foreign key): points at another record's key.
A product's key is sku + warehouse together (Q10),
so links to a product use two fields.
Grey boxes are stored inside their parent.
stock changed by: Movement sku + warehouse
assigned to: Shipment carrier = Carrier name
circle + crow's foot: zero or more
